name: medmcqa-conv-bench
description: Conversational adaptation of the MedMCQA medical question-answering benchmark that evaluates model performance on clinically oriented multiple-choice questions presented in a dialogue-like format. It measures a model's medical knowledge, reasoning, and ability to select the correct option in multi-turn or conversational contexts. Useful for assessing medical LLMs intended for clinical QA and education.
reputation: Derived from the widely used MedMCQA benchmark and referenced in research on medical language models; recognized in the medical-AI research community.
